mobbin:2523ca18-b9ac-4576-8555-a20d27016.summary: From My Meetings list, open a recording and review AI Summary then Chapters with timestamped bullets beside video and a speaker talk-time timeline.
steps: Summary tab + tip: click timed AI notes
steal: Step 2: Onboarding tip 'Skip to the important parts' teaches that AI Outcomes with timestamps jump video + transcript.
Step 2–3: Outcomes and Action Items each carry clickable times linking claim → evidence moment.
Step 3: Speaker timeline under video shows % talk time + colored bars, with empty Comments/Clips rows ready for markers.
Step 4: Chapters list nests timed bullets under each chapter; chapter name overlays the video scrubber.
avoid: AI Summary/Chapters are live with Share/Ask AI immediately — no faculty edit/approve gate before learners see them (Baseline wants human review).
mobbin:2523ca18-b9ac-4576-8555-a20d27016.fit: Extends SRV right-panel Annotation/Transcript with AI Purpose·Chapters·Outcomes·Action Items; speaker timeline complements chapter markers; clashes with Baseline if AI notes auto-show on the debrief big screen.

mobbin:47438eb0-03cb-427d-a962-dd32fd19c.summary: Open a meeting review, switch Summary → searchable speaker-labelled Transcript synced to video, then use a focused player with 10s skips and 1x speed.
steal: Step 2: Search transcript with hit highlight ('Grain') while speaker colors match the timeline bars.
Step 2: Transcript tab sits peer to Summary/Chapters — same panel, one click to verify AI claims against dialogue.
Step 3: Minimal player keeps chapter chip, 10s ±, and explicit 1x speed without chrome competing with the room display.
mobbin:47438eb0-03cb-427d-a962-dd32fd19c.fit: Maps cleanly onto SRV left video + right Transcript/Annotation tabs and chaptered timeline; focused player is a candidate big-screen-only mode while phone holds notes.

mobbin:6b6443d7-dcb9-4e6e-b6a1-d82455a1f.summary: On Coaching Scorecard for a multi-person recording, pick/add a scorecard for one speaker, answer Y/N and 1–5 items with N/A and notes, submit, then see results under video with Send to Sam.
steps: Scorecard rubric + avg score under video
steal: Step 1: Rubric rows with 1–5 color chips + large avg badge beside multi-tile video — grade while rewatching.
Step 3: New Scorecard gates Speaker, Scorecard template, and Viewable-by before scoring starts.
Step 4→5: Submit stays disabled until required answers; N/A on each item.
Step 1/8: Persistent 'Send to Sam' shares the finished review to one named learner.
avoid: Scores one speaker at a time — no whole-team grade with per-person overrides in one pass (Baseline dominant group-grading mode).
mobbin:6b6443d7-dcb9-4e6e-b6a1-d82455a1f.fit: Extends SRV Data Entry with rubric under video and named share-out; useful for individual overrides inside a team session, but needs a group-first shell Essentials plans as default.
